Use case: ui-mockup.
Create realistic, production-quality UI designs with clear hierarchy, strong typography and purposeful spacing.
Primary request: complete the remaining subpages and states of PaperMono, an existing 480x800 monochrome e-paper terminal in zephyr-mono. This is a continuation of the SAME already selected Field Notes design language, not new style alternatives. Source behavior comes from src/papermono_ui.c and DESIGN.md. Do not invent functionality.
Input image 1 = actual implemented home/apps/reader, STYLE REFERENCE ONLY.
Input image 2 = generated and selected page-family board, STYLE AND COMPONENT REFERENCE ONLY.
Generate one wide board with exactly FIVE complete equal portrait UI screens in a left-to-right row, not five separate conceptual directions. Target canvas2560x960; each individual screen has native aspect ratio480x800 (3:5), content never stretched. Approx top128 bottom928, x32,536,1040,1544,2048, gutters24. Board heading above screens, small caption “设计参考 · 示例数据 · 480 × 800”. Match proportions of supplied boards. No perspective or phone hardware. Use plain white throughout with thin straight viewport boundary only.
Design invariants: pure black ink on pure white, elegant Song/Source Han Serif large Chinese headings, restrained Bodoni-like serif numerals for primary numbers, small clean sans metadata. No colored or gray fills, no shadows, gradients, decorative paper textures or dithering. All label/body/secondary text in solid black. Typography and white space differentiate hierarchy, then thin rules; ordinary content is unboxed. Square corners on actual action buttons, matching existing launcher geometric outline icons. No card nesting, no rounded toggles, no filled-gray selection backgrounds. Readable24px primary content, 16-20px metadata, 40-46px section heading; content inset22px; no clipped words or oversize dense text.
Common page header: small PAPERMONO branding and “09月30日 周三” above large serif page title; fine horizontal rule below. Stable footer at y724 with thin rule, “‹ 返回” at left, contextual hint at right. Preserve same typography, rule weight and touch target size across all five.
Use natural focus on one existing workflow per screen. Avoid extra panels, random metrics, search/compose/edit buttons, account login, OS statusbars, device bezel, notch, keyboard, browser chrome. Empty pages should use meaningful generous white space with one concise message and appropriate small geometric line icon, not giant empty card borders.

Board heading “FIELD NOTES / 内容详情与阅读”.
Five screens left-to-right:
1. “便签内容” — existing read-only Markdown detail. Note heading “阅读摘记”; small top-right filled black bookmark = favorite. Main content below:
subheading “关于留白”
paragraph “留白让文字有了呼吸的空间，也让阅读的节奏慢下来。”
quote with thin black vertical quote rule: “一页纸，只留下值得记住的几句话。”
subheading “今天的记录”
two list items “整理本周阅读片段” and “保留清晰的段落层级”.
Finish with fine horizontal separator and small “Markdown · 已收藏”. Footer “长按切换收藏”. No editor or save/share action. Body typography close to actual reader.
2. “微信读书” — detail subtitle “书籍详情”. Text-only small book spine, large book name “雪国”, author “川端康成”. No fabricated cover illustration. Large “37%” reading progress; progress track436px, black filled portion EXACTLY37%, remaining thin line. Aligned metadata list below: “类型 / 电子书”, “累计阅读 / 2 小时 18 分钟”, “更新时间 / 09月30日”, “阅读状态 / 未读完”. Thin separator then small “本地书架摘要” and “正文请在手机或电脑端阅读。” Footer “左右键切换书籍”. Do not draw on-device start-reading button: this app has metadata only.
3. “信息卡片” — POPULATED state, subtitle “示例数据源”. Three flat rule-separated sections with title, short summary and factual source/freshness/update labels, all text black:
“本周阅读摘要”; “本周整理了三篇阅读摘记。”; “示例源 A · 最新 · 09月30日 09:20”.
“资料同步提醒”; “请定期备份 TF 卡资料。”; “示例源 B · 离线缓存 · 09月29日 18:00”.
“数据更新”; “当前无法获取新内容，保留已有缓存。”; “示例源 C · 获取失败 · 09月30日 08:50”.
Use clear freshness labels without colored badges, neutral fine rules and small line icons if needed. Footer “01 / 01”. No stock/weather/provider invention or clickable detail page.
4. “内容中心” — example PAIRED/LAN state. Subtitle “示例连接状态”. Large section “本地会话已建立” with understated black check mark and smaller “浏览器刷新会自动恢复”. Thin rule. “局域网地址” with big serif “192.168.1.63”. “内容版本 / 12”. Another section “首次配网接入点 / 已关闭”. Bottom thin-separated “管理范围” and “书籍 · 日历 · 待办 · 便签”. Footer “浏览器传输在后台执行”. No obsolete pairing code now that session is paired, no fake completed progress bar.
5. “阅读菜单” — TXT-specific variant subtitle “山间来信 · TXT”. Seven spaced ruled rows:
“添加当前页书签”;
“目录” with subtitle “TXT 没有内置目录”, no enabled right arrow on this row;
“排版与编码” with “标准 · UTF-8” and small “轻触密度 · 长按编码”;
“前光亮度” / “50%”;
“书签列表” / “3 个位置”;
“返回阅读”;
“返回书库”.
Small simple matching line icons where useful, no new control panel, no density radio dialog or font-size slider. Footer “进度与书签自动保存”.
Make all five screens visually faithful to the supplied already selected reference.

Board heading “FIELD NOTES / 确认与异常”.
Five screens left-to-right:
1. “连接设置” — Wi-Fi reset confirmation. Simple Wi-Fi line icon centered above “确认重新配网？” set large serif but fitting width. Body “将清除已保存的网络配置。” and “内容文件不会删除。” Ample whitespace. Two stacked square outlined buttons “确认重新配网” and “取消”. Footer “取消可返回上一页”. No password field or fake QR code.
2. “连接设置” — BLE bonds reset confirmation. Simple BLE geometric icon above large serif question “确认清除配对？”; body “将删除已保存的蓝牙主机。” and “内容文件不会删除。” Same exactly-positioned buttons “确认清除配对” and “取消”. Footer “取消可返回上一页”. No phone account signout implication.
3. “设备设置” — defaults reset confirmation. Simple circular-reset line icon above large serif question “恢复默认设置？”; body “偏好设置将恢复为默认值。” and “内容文件不会删除。” Small “此操作需要确认”. Same exactly-positioned buttons “确认恢复” and “取消”. Footer “取消可返回上一页”. Never call this formatting/wipe/reset-contents.
4. “书签” — book subtitle “雪国”. Simple outline bookmark icon centered in upper-middle; title “尚无书签”; text “阅读时长按页面，” next line “或在阅读菜单中添加当前页书签。” Intentionally generous blank space. No add-bookmark button here because empty list itself has no such action. Footer “返回阅读菜单”.

“雪国” / “EPUB · 462 KiB”;
“山间来信” / “TXT · 86 KiB”;
“时间的形状” / “EPUB · 1,280 KiB”;
“旅途札记” / “TXT · 128 KiB”;
“纸上风景” / “EPUB · 720 KiB”.
